# Techo Labs

> Techo Labs is the digital engineering, AI search optimization (SEO, AEO, GEO, AIO, SXO), performance marketing, and market intelligence division of Techo Traders (Pvt) Ltd — headquartered in Batticaloa, Sri Lanka and serving clients across 8+ countries including Canada, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom, France, the UAE, and Australia.

## Core Facts
- **Brand / Division**: Techo Labs (Established 2021)
- **Parent Company**: [Techo Traders (Pvt) Ltd](https://www.techotraders.com.lk/)
- **Sister Divisions**: [Techo Connect](https://www.connect.techotraders.com.lk/) (Telecom & Antenna Hardware) and [Techo Xpress](https://www.express.techotraders.com.lk/) (Courier & Smart Logistics)
- **Headquarters**: Batticaloa, Eastern Province, Sri Lanka (Global Remote Delivery)
- **Direct Contact**: labs@techotraders.com.lk | +94 76 665 6007
- **Track Record**: 24+ live production websites & SaaS platforms, 8+ countries served, 98% client retention, <0.8s target Largest Contentful Paint (LCP).

## Core Capabilities
- [Next-Gen Web & Product Engineering](https://labs.techotraders.com.lk/services#web): Custom Next.js & React Server Component web apps, UI/UX design systems, headless CMS (Sanity, Strapi, WordPress), e-commerce (Shopify, WooCommerce), and custom portals/tracking software.
- [Omnichannel Growth & AI Search](https://labs.techotraders.com.lk/services#marketing): Unified SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), AIO (AI Optimization), SXO (Search Experience Optimization), Google Ads, Meta Ads, and CRO.
- [Market & Competitive Intelligence](https://labs.techotraders.com.lk/services#research): Competitor teardowns, TAM/demand sizing, buyer persona research, search intent mapping, and executive Go-To-Market (GTM) roadmaps.

## The Techo Ecosystem
- [Techo Traders (Pvt) Ltd](https://www.techotraders.com.lk/): Parent company uniting digital intelligence, hardware manufacturing, and express logistics.
- [Techo Labs](https://labs.techotraders.com.lk/): Digital engineering, AI search growth, and market intelligence division.
- [Techo Connect](https://www.connect.techotraders.com.lk/): Antenna manufacturing, RF connectivity, and telecom hardware division of Techo Traders (Pvt) Ltd.
- [Techo Xpress](https://www.express.techotraders.com.lk/): Express courier and smart logistics division of Techo Traders (Pvt) Ltd, powered by Techo Labs tracking software.
